name: @mnemosyne-plugins/mnemo-crm
description: The customer book of a small business, a freelancer or a craftsperson: clients, follow-ups that ring, and the memory of every exchange. Your files, on your machine.

descriptionI18n.en: The customer book of a small business, a freelancer or a craftsperson: clients, follow-ups that ring, and the memory of every exchange. Your files, on your machine.
descriptionI18n.fr: Le carnet clients d'une petite entreprise, d'un indépendant ou d'un artisan : les clients, les relances qui sonnent, et la mémoire de chaque échange. Vos fichiers, sur votre machine.
descriptionI18n.es: La libreta de clientes de una pequeña empresa, un autónomo o un artesano: los clientes, los recordatorios que suenan y la memoria de cada intercambio. Tus archivos, en tu equipo.

agentGuide: Name a client, a deal, a stage or a product the way the person says it (« Marie Dupont », « le vase de Paul », « devis envoyé »): every action takes the words as well as an id. Refused AMBIGUOUS: the names listed are the candidates, pick one and call again; NO_CLIENT / NO_DEAL / NO_STAGE / NO_PRODUCT list the names that exist.
To look at something: openClient (a client's sheet), showDeal, showProduct, showTab (a screen), showClients (filter the list by words; no query clears it). closeView closes what is open.
A deal moves with moveDeal to one of the person's own stages; closeDeal marks it won or lost, reopenDeal undoes that. updateDeal changes its title, amount or client.
Find a client with clients, read one with client, then act (addNote, planFollowUp, followUpDone). A client who refused contact keeps follow-ups out of the agenda.
addClient may be refused LICENSE_REQUIRED: say it, never work around it.

agentActions.summary: List or search the clients: id, name, company, email, phone, tags, next follow-up day, number of exchanges.
agentActions.details: query matches every word anywhere in the client (name, company, email, phone, tags, address, notes), accents ignored. Sorted by name. Absent fields are absent, never empty.

query.description: Words to look for; empty = every client.

agentActions.summary: One client in full: contact facts, consent to be contacted, next follow-up, the history of exchanges newest first, and their deals.
agentActions.details: consent is yes, no or unknown (never asked). history holds the 50 newest exchanges; historyNotShown counts the rest.

clientId.description: The client as the person says it (full name, first name, company) or an id from clients.

agentActions.summary: Who to follow up: the overdue follow-ups, today's, and the coming ones, clients and deal next steps together.
agentActions.details: kind client or deal with its id; today is the local day. A client's follow-up is closed with followUpDone.

soonDays.description: How many days ahead count as coming (default 7).

agentActions.summary: List the deals: title, client, stage (the person's own words), amount, next step. Open deals only unless closed is true.

clientId.description: Only this client's deals: the client as the person says it, or an id from clients.

closed.description: Also list the won and lost deals.

agentActions.summary: Add a client to the book and show their sheet on screen.
agentActions.details: Only the name is required. Refused with LICENSE_REQUIRED when the free book is full.

name.description: The client's name, as the person writes it.

company.description: The company a person works at (kept for a person only).

source.description: Where this client came from ("Christmas market Lyon 2025", "Instagram").

tags.description: Tags, each a short word. Replaces the client's tags.

agentActions.summary: Change a client's contact facts, tags or consent, and show their sheet on screen.
agentActions.details: Only the fields passed change; a field cannot be emptied from here. consent records the client's own answer to being contacted again: yes, no, or unknown.

clientId.description: The client as the person says it (full name, first name, company) or an id from clients.

name.description: The client's name, as the person writes it.

company.description: The company a person works at (kept for a person only).

source.description: Where this client came from ("Christmas market Lyon 2025", "Instagram").

tags.description: Tags, each a short word. Replaces the client's tags.

consent.description: The client's answer to being contacted again.

agentActions.summary: Add an exchange to a client's history (a note, a call, a meeting or a sale) and show their sheet on screen.

clientId.description: The client as the person says it (full name, first name, company) or an id from clients.

source.description: Where it comes from when the person did not type it (a file, a mail).

agentActions.summary: Plan a client's next follow-up on a day, put it in the person's agenda (rings at 9:00), and show their sheet.
agentActions.details: Replaces the client's follow-up. A client who said no to being contacted again keeps it in the book but never in the agenda (CONTACT_REFUSED). inAgenda false with a reason means saved in the book only. The first agenda write may open a permission window for the person.

clientId.description: The client as the person says it (full name, first name, company) or an id from clients.

agentActions.summary: Mark a client's follow-up done: it leaves the client and becomes a call in the history, as the sheet's Done button does.

clientId.description: The client as the person says it (full name, first name, company) or an id from clients.

agentActions.summary: Show a client's sheet on the person's screen.

clientId.description: The client as the person says it (full name, first name, company) or an id from clients.

agentActions.summary: Show a screen of MnemoCRM: today, clients, deals, catalog, sales, analytics or settings.
Show the client list filtered by words, as typed in the search box; no query clears the filter.
agentActions.details: The words match anywhere in the client (name, company, email, phone, tags, address, notes), accents ignored. Answers how many clients match.

query.description: Words to filter on; absent = every client.

agentActions.summary: Close what is open on screen: the open dialog, else the client's sheet. Says what it closed (nothing when nothing was open).
Open a deal on the person's screen (open or closed).

deal.description: The deal as the person says it (its title, or its client's name) or an id from deals.

agentActions.summary: Move an open deal to one of the person's stages, as dragging its card on the board does, and show the board.
agentActions.details: stage is the person's own word for it (the board's column titles), or a stage id. A closed deal is refused DEAL_CLOSED: reopenDeal first. Already there answers changed false.

deal.description: The deal as the person says it (its title, or its client's name) or an id from deals.

stage.description: The stage as the person names it, e.g. "Devis envoyé".

agentActions.summary: Mark an open deal won or lost, as the deal's Won and Lost buttons do, and show the board.

deal.description: The deal as the person says it (its title, or its client's name) or an id from deals.

agentActions.summary: Reopen a won or lost deal: it goes back to its stage on the board.

deal.description: The deal as the person says it (its title, or its client's name) or an id from deals.

agentActions.summary: Change a deal's title, amount or client, or add a line to its history, and show the board.
agentActions.details: Only the fields passed change; the amount is in the book's currency. Nothing passed is refused NOTHING_TO_CHANGE.

deal.description: The deal as the person says it (its title, or its client's name) or an id from deals.

amount.description: The amount, in the book's currency.

client.description: The client the deal is for, as the person says it, or an id.

note.description: A line for the deal's history.

agentActions.summary: Open a product of the catalogue on the person's screen.

product.description: The product as the person says it (its name) or an id.

agentActions.summary: Mark a unique piece available, reserved or sold, as the catalogue's buttons do, and show the catalogue.
agentActions.details: A series has a stock, not a status: refused NOT_UNIQUE (use adjustStock). This does not record a sale in the journal.

product.description: The product as the person says it (its name) or an id.

agentActions.summary: Add to or take from a series' stock, as the catalogue's + and - do (never below zero), and show the catalogue.
agentActions.details: A product with no stock count is refused STOCK_NOT_TRACKED.

product.description: The product as the person says it (its name) or an id.

delta.description: How many to add (+5) or take away (-1).
